messages:
jessica: Customer reported streaming chat sessions dropping after ~65s of idle, then a sudden billing spike. They say client reconnects create duplicate invoice items. Repro steps attached.
marc: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro? which LB / front is in front of us? ALB, CF, envoy?
aj: customer on ALB -> Cloudflare -> our private ingress (nginx). They hit keepalive silence after idle, then reconnect loop.
jessica: repro steps they gave:
```
1) open SSE /chat stream
2) wait ~65s with no tokens
3) server sends next chunk -> client sees truncated last-chunk, connection resets
4) client reconnects immediately, server resumes and charges new tokens
```
marc: 65s rings alarm bells — ALB default idle timeout is 60. CF can aggregate chunks too. any traces from our edge? logs?
lee: pulled traces from ingress (nginx) and runtime. ingress shows `connection: keep-alive` but a SYN,RST at ~62s in tcpdump from ALB side. Runtime got a half-close and emitted final chunk but client never acknowledged.
jessica: can you paste the nginx config snippet that might cause buffering? maybe `proxy_buffering` on.
lee: current snippet from customer VPC template:
```
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_max_temp_file_size 0;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection '';
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
marc: `proxy_buffering on` + ALB idle close will cause nginx to accumulate before flush => partial-last-chunk behavior. Suggest `proxy_buffering off` and send heartbeat 15s.
aj: also note Cloudflare can coalesce small chunks. CF may hide our keepalive heartbeats if buffering. They have `always_use_chunked_encoding` toggles.
jessica: customer claims auth token rotation coincides with reconnects. billing-bot: Billing noticed duplicate token usage events when client reconnects within 5s of disconnect -> double-charge. We should debounce billing on resumed sessions.
marc: tactical steps to propose to customer:
- set ALB idle timeout >= 300s (or match expected idle)
- set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";` on ingress
- add an application heartbeat every 15s (commented as `:keepalive:` event)
- enable `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and avoid `Content-Length`
- make client backoff on reconnects (jittered 2-10s)
lee: commands we used to repro locally against an ALB mTLS test env:
```
# server: simple sse with deliberate 70s idle
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://staging-api.example.com/stream
# client: simulate quick reconnect
while true; do curl -sS -N https://staging-api.example.com/stream; sleep 1; done
```
jessica: created a support ticket (INC-2026-789) and escalated to eng-runtime. adding logs and pcap to the ticket.
support-bot: Automated note: customer session id=cs_8421, sample logs uploaded to ticket.
marc: eng-runtime action items:
- verify nginx buffering/shutdown flush behavior in our ingress image (lee)
- add guard in billing to detect immediate resumed sessions and avoid double invoice line items (bill-plat)
- add automated test in e2e harness to simulate ALB/CF idle close and verify stream integrity (aj)
lee: quick fix we tested: turning off proxy_buffering and sending `:\n` heartbeat every 15s prevented disconnects and stopped duplicate billing in our local ALB env.
jessica: Customer happy to test changes; scheduling a maintenance window with them tomorrow 10:00 PST.
marc: leaving a note — long-term we should document recommended network topology and timeout matrix (ALB=300, CF=240, client-heartbeat=15s) in docs.
aj: can someone own the billing debounce change? assigning to @marc
marc: taking billing debounce. will follow up with spec by EOD.
jessica: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post resolution once customer verifies.
